articleBodyHtml:
不運な朝の始まり

この日は、痛ましい事故とチキンサンドイッチへの渇望で始まった。朝はなんとなくのんびりしていたが、ベッドから出た途端、直ぐにピンと突き刺さったステインレス製のピンに足を踏みつけるというアクシデントに遭遇した。

この日は、本当に最悪な始まりだった。しかし、チキンサンドイッチがあれば、少しは気分が良くなるかもしれない。その思いで、家の外へ出かけた。

timeline.text: The morning started off kinda lazy, I hit the jack
Rolled out of bed and stepped on a straight thumbtack
I thought, damn, this day is turning out like a bitch
What could make it better? Shit, I know, a fuckin' chicken sandwich
I left the house, hit my favorite joint
Where the bread ain't all that soggy and the chicken on point
Through the doors I explode, like Don and Mike
The drink's blowin' like my bars and I want that bite
Walk up to the register with sweater and poise
I find myself in front of some scrawny teenage boy
Wouldn't be surprised if the kid was one of my fans
So I lower my glasses and stare as long as I can
He says, uh, sir, can I take your order?
I would've called him kinda cute if he was just a bit shorter
I rub my eyes, though, because I gotta keep my cool
And say I'm tryna get a fuckin' chicken sandwich, fool
He looks at me with dead eyes and now I wanna punch him out
But I hold back my pride cause it's too bad for my clout
He says, do you want fries? I say, the fuck do you think?
He says, another dollar fifty, you can choose a drink
I say, okay, let's get a cola, he says, sorry, we're out
Well, fuck it, guess I'll get a lemonade and start up the shop
He asks me, do you want a smaller or larger? I say, large, man
He says, alright, that's gonna be another dollar then
I roll my eyes and say, fine, I'll get the small
He says, will that complete your order? Like, he ten feet tall
I say, you didn't ask me for the size of the sandwich or the fries
Cashier boy reviews this shit, says, I apologize
If you want the special small combo, you get a discount
I say, alright, that sounds kinda nice, but what's the fry count?
Uh, something like eight fries, now fuck that shit
I've had, go ahead and get your boy a big super size
Hey sir, would you like an apple pie or dessert with your meal?
I look the bitch in the eyes and say with nerves of steel
I'll take a soft serve ice cream cone or a cup
Give me a cone, bitch, order done, now shut the fuck up
Total $7.99, sir, hand him a ten
I don't even count the change, just stare at him again
Get the mayonnaise out, my fucking sandwich, boy
Or I'll tear the roof off the place and leave it to stroll
He says, I just put the order in, we gotta redo it
I say, no way, and hell, he says, I'll tell the cook
Bitch, I knew it, lazy ass little kid
Got me looking like the bad guy
Take my seat and wait for my chicken and fries
And fuck shit, in my anger I forgot my drink
The empty cup is waiting on the counter, right by the sink
I grab the motherfucker before I hit the ice machine
